Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS pref_name, drug_indication.mesh_id AS mesh_id, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS mesh_heading, drug_indication.mesh_id AS indication_curie, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind
Join drug_indication ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno
Filter drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind = 3
Filter molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1
Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind
